Chase Investment Counsel Corp decreased its stake in Fiserv Inc (FISV) by 33.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 25,151 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.30M, down from 37,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chase Investment Counsel Corp who had been investing in Fiserv Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $28.81 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $70.36. About 1.49M shares traded. Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV) has risen 21.71% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.16% the S&P500.
